known-problems.title: ordeal < 0.22.1: shifts and rotations at non-power-of-two bit-widths are mis-encoded, so satisfiable formulas can be reported unsatisfiable (fixed in ordeal 0.22.1)
known-problems.workaround: None inside this layer. Move to a layer carrying ordeal 0.22.1 or later (2026.09.18 onwards).

known-problems.title: meld <= 0.61.0: --memory shared --address-rebase could discard a component's address rebasing, causing cross-component memory corruption (fixed in meld 0.62.0)
known-problems.workaround: Avoid --memory shared together with --address-rebase, or move to a layer carrying meld 0.62.0 or later.

known-problems.title: wsc 0.11.0 embeds rustls 0.23.34: Debug impls for client session values expose TLS secrets (GHSA-c8m5-c952-6cm4; fixed in rustls 0.23.46)
known-problems.workaround: No layer yet carries a wsc built on rustls 0.23.46 or later.

known-problems.title: wsc 0.11.0 embeds rustls 0.23.34: Brotli certificate decompression can allocate up to 1 GiB before authentication (GHSA-h2v8-394m-p7vv; fixed in rustls 0.23.46)
known-problems.workaround: No layer yet carries a wsc built on rustls 0.23.46 or later.
